identity_map_energy: If ell_ij=alpha_j-alpha_i>0 and c=kappa/ell, then (1/2)sum c(Delta alpha)^2=(kappa/2)sum ell; at fixed circumference this is constant.
interpretation: alpha is a valid translation-covariant geometry coordinate; beta is one invariant transverse deformation but is not complete by itself. gamma is an independent translation-invariant deformation unless separately frozen/slaved.
inverse: phi3=3 alpha+gamma; phi4=4 alpha+gamma; phi5=5 alpha+beta+gamma
title: Separate translation geometry from internal phase deformation
